body: Real bug found and fixed: idunaclient.Client was sending the raw agent secret as a Bearer token, which IDUNA's real JWT verification has always rejected -- every IDUNA call from apps2/mud and apps2/server-go has been silently failing (confirmed live, characters table was empty). Fixed with a real POST /api/v1/auth/agent login exchange, cached/refreshed. Verified live: character creation now succeeds against the running IDUNA service. Also fixed a real, stable UUIDv4 player_id (was a raw socket address). New battlegrounds/bg command mints a real ticket and prints the join command. 6 new tests. Commit 9dc9bc5.
title: REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR Milestone 3: Battlegrounds entry point + real IDUNA auth fix
